page.layout: One printed page: running head "INDEX" at top; a table of contents (index entries with page numbers at the right) in one column; catchword-like signature line "St 4" and "Raia" at the foot, which are signature marks.

main_text.l: Quæstio an subiectum morbi & sanitatis sit ipsius partis essentia 6
Quæstio an humores sint subiectum morbi & sanitatis 8
Quæstio largius sit cœnandum quam prandendum 74
Quæstio utrum sit magis obnoxium, potando an vorando excedere modum 82
Quæstio an à potu omnino sit abstinendum inter medio prandii & cœna tempore 89
Quæstio an hyeme plus edere conveniat quam æstate, propterea quod ventres sint tempore hiberno calidiores, æstate vero frigidiores 91
Quæstio an alimentum sit tantum dicendum quod nutrit 103
Quæstio morbi communes etiam oriantur à malorum ciborum copia & culpa 109
Quæstio an ciborum natura & potestas ad varia gentium ingenia moresque aliquid conferat 111
Quæstio, morbi quod quibusdam gentibus peculiariter accidant, an victus ratio in causa sit, & cur repente quidam hominibus oriantur in certis membris consuetudinem deniq; plurimum valeat 122

page.notes: Scan is a faded page; some words in the index lines are uncertain (e.g. "moresq;", "deniq;", "valeat" read as "valera"). The running head is "INDEX" with a numeral mark. The signature at the foot is partly illegible and reads approximately "St 4" and "Raia".
